title: Power Echoes: Investigating Moderation Biases in Online Power-Asymmetric Conflicts

bias_targets.methodology: A mixed design experiment utilizing perturbed consumer-merchant conflict samples to measure how various 'power manifestations' (such as legitimate claims, punishment threats, expert knowledge, compensation offers, and response length) influence human moderators to favor the more powerful party.

A Wizard-of-Oz study providing AI-generated suggestions to moderators to evaluate whether the presence of AI advice amplifies or mitigates power-related biases and induces algorithmic compliance (e.g., the 'legitimizing' effect of AI citing rules).
